assets.prompt: Create ONE polished cartoon game UI BUTTON for Playground Classics, a reusable transparent PNG. Front-facing perfectly straight-on view, NOT isometric. A square button with generously rounded corners, thick deep navy outer border, a narrow pale-cream highlight rim, a thick darker lower bevel giving it a toy-like raised push-button appearance. Button is centered and fully visible with 10% transparent margin on all sides. Saturated smooth glossy cel-shaded face, a broad restrained gloss sweep across the top third, subtle sparse comic halftone dots only near the edges. Clean bold silhouette, readable at 64 pixels. Central icon fills about 60% of the face and is optically centered. Style: cheerful chunky cartoon toy game UI, thick navy outlines, broad highlights, smooth bevels, same style as glossy colourful Dodge and Sprint playground buttons. No text or letters anywhere, no labels, no extra objects, no stars or detached sparkles, no background scene, no floor or cast shadow, no watermark. Outside the rounded button is genuinely transparent. The button face is bright CYAN BLUE with an azure lower bevel. The central icon is one pair of chunky cream-and-navy BINOCULARS seen mostly from the front, two large circular vivid cyan glass lenses with simple broad white reflections, a short cream bridge connecting the two barrels, small dark navy eyepiece shapes behind them. Symmetrical binocular silhouette, two lenses aligned horizontally, no eyes or face. Keep the binocular icon clean, playful, and instantly recognisable.
